Every other ballot also elects a president. Local preferences, settled domestic service uptake, the executive record, issue positions and bounded campaign effort shape results.

catalog.assumptions: Fictional regional balance, not official statistics. Population and output weights are authored shares. Equal component weights define each index. Observed delivered work affects components after two settled months; private media fees do not purchase welfare or authority.

messages.civic.election_briefing: The election count is in. Open Civic for the seat breakdown, economic inputs and dates when the new terms begin.
messages.civic.implementation_briefing: A policy completed agency implementation today. Open Civic for the effective jurisdiction, eligibility rules and expiration.
messages.operations.site.outcome: Operations recorded a site outcome. Review its cause, current capacity and recovery terms in Operations.
messages.slice.demand.decrease: A fictional business spending cycle lowers discretionary enterprise demand by 20% for 30 days. Existing signed task promises remain protected.
messages.slice.demand.expired: The temporary demand condition has expired. Base demand resumes; completed work and settled bills are unchanged.
messages.slice.demand.increase: A fictional business spending cycle raises enterprise demand by 20% for 30 days. Customer budgets and existing signed commitments do not change.
messages.slice.evaluation.finding: Held-out evidence found a task limitation. Read the named subgroup result in the Lab. Compare the available consented scans ($8,000), paid retraining and a fresh test, or limit the product promise. Opening this report buys nothing.
messages.slice.finance.recovered: The warned obligations have been resolved. Past expenses and the original response window remain in the accounts.
messages.slice.finance.workout: An actual liquidity warning opened a 30-day response window. Review unpaid obligations, cash commitments and financing. This alert does not reset the deadline.
messages.slice.pilot.outcome: Customer settlement recorded. The attached cause reports actual delivery or a missed start. Fees, credits and penalties are already in the accounts; this bulletin creates no second payment.
messages.slice.recovery.accepted: The narrower pilot is active. Actual useful work, fees and service credits will flow through the ordinary market and accounts.
messages.slice.recovery.text: A customer offers a 90-day document-only pilot: 500 useful tasks/day for $45,000/month. It needs an eligible available product, protected serving capacity and existing support. Acceptance starts real service today; payment follows actual delivery. No setup payment or new capital is granted.
messages.slice.recovery.title: A narrower pilot
messages.slice.research.completed: Research completed. The new method unlocks its listed recipes or evaluation options; this bulletin grants no additional research.
messages.slice.rival.notice: A competitor has a new public development. Check the visible company notices and any dated warning. Private scores and research plans are not disclosed. A heavyweight warning provides at least 90 days before its financed work can start.
messages.slice.supplier.accepted: The lease is signed. Its source, setup expense, monthly obligation and expiry are recorded. Declining would have created no commitment.
messages.slice.supplier.text: Optional: 30 CU/day for 180 days, $1,000 setup and $4,000 per calendar month including power. This adds a separate source; it does not replace or refund the initial lease. Capacity ends at the disclosed expiry.
messages.slice.supplier.title: A smaller cloud lease
messages.society.monthly_briefing: Regional work has settled. World shows actual delivery, public-service access, energy demand and concentration. Welfare changes follow the published lag; population-weighted values and each region are shown separately.
messages.society.forum_briefing: The standards forum has a dated update. Review each member’s support, implementation date and expiration in World. Effective agent access requires the disclosed independent lower bound; a report and redeployment can restore eligibility.

variables.help: Last competitive notice included in a player briefing.
